List available CT versions

Source: R/available_versions.R
available_ct_versions.Rd

List available CT versions

Usage

available_ct_versions(type = c("sdtm", "adam"))

Arguments

type

One of "sdtm" or "adam".

Value

Character vector of version date strings, newest first, e.g. c("2026-03-27", "2025-09-27", ...).

Examples

available_ct_versions("sdtm")
#>  [1] "2026-03-27" "2025-09-26" "2025-03-28" "2024-09-27" "2024-03-29"
#>  [6] "2023-12-15" "2023-09-29" "2023-06-30" "2023-03-31" "2022-12-16"

#> [21] "2020-06-26" "2020-05-08" "2020-03-27" "2019-12-20" "2019-09-27"
#> [26] "2019-06-28" "2019-03-29" "2019-01-07" "2018-12-21" "2018-09-28"
#> [31] "2018-06-29" "2018-03-30" "2017-12-22" "2017-09-29" "2017-06-30"
#> [36] "2017-03-31" "2016-12-16" "2016-09-30" "2016-06-24" "2016-03-25"
#> [41] "2015-12-18" "2015-09-25" "2015-06-26" "2015-03-27" "2014-12-19"

#> [51] "2013-10-04" "2013-06-28" "2013-04-12" "2012-12-21" "2012-08-03"
